documents.text:
## Symptoms
On Ubuntu 24.04 engineering workstations, the Northwind VPN (WireGuard profile) drops after the laptop sleeps or after a kernel update.

## Fix
1. Run `nmcli connection down northwind-vpn` and then `nmcli connection up northwind-vpn`.
2. If the profile is missing, re-import it from the self-service portal under **Downloads > Linux VPN profile**.

## Script
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Northwind VPN reconnect (Linux). Scope: this workstation, NetworkManager profile only.
nmcli connection down northwind-vpn || true
nmcli connection up northwind-vpn
nmcli -t -f NAME,STATE connection show --active | grep northwind
```

## Notes
During scheduled power load-shedding, the Lahore office runs on generator power and the main switch restarts once. Wi-Fi returns within two minutes. If the VPN drops at the same time, reconnect after the Wi-Fi is back rather than resetting the profile.

## Policy
Never uninstall or reinstall the VPN client yourself. Since the September 2026 client, reinstalling removes the device certificate and locks the laptop out of the network until the help desk re-enrolls it. Use **Reset profile** in the VPN client, or reset your VPN profile from the self-service portal.
